publication_scope: research-only summary; no software repository release

original_benchmark.port_and_materials: air incidence; semi-infinite SiO2-R film-data optical set used as substrate in these historical studies

fixed_center_multistacks.search_limit: finite center grids, bounded low-dimensional matching; no arbitrary 32-layer optimization or continuous-center exhaustive proof

independent_junction_buffers_B2.all_k_zero_status: attribution diagnostic only; not a material correction, candidate qualification, or benchmark pass

material_and_TMM_assumptions_audit.finding: no evidence of a layer order, unit, phase, or admittance implementation error in checked points
material_and_TMM_assumptions_audit.substrate_caveat: historical 32/70-layer audits use a thin-film SiO2-R dataset as semi-infinite substrate; source says it is not bulk fused silica

tfcalc_43_physical_layer_public_referenc.reframed_in_solver_order: reverse source list for air-to-glass incidence
tfcalc_43_physical_layer_public_referenc.source_goal: approximately 98% average p reflectance, not >=98% spectral minimum
tfcalc_43_physical_layer_public_referenc.relation_to_original_benchmark: different specification and 43 physical layers; not a pass of hr_broad_visible

tfcalc_43_fixed_geometry_material_substi.qualification: fixed-geometry diagnostic only; not optimized, not a bulk-SiO2 design, not the original benchmark

MgF2-R.description: 2017 deposited-film dataset, 250 C tungsten-boat thermal evaporation; 44 nm sample

ZnS-A.description: 2020 e-beam deposited film, 120 C, Ge substrate, about 1.008 um sample

SiO2-R.description: 2016 reactive e-beam deposited film data; not bulk fused silica

not_included.low_k_and_bulk_sio2_run: not yet finalized; not represented by this historical dataset

methods_limit: Dense/shifted grids plus bracketed extrema are strong numerical audits, not interval-arithmetic proofs or fabrication tolerance validation.
